title: PR #50: audit: systematic code, integration and CI hardening
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Systematic repository audit — 2026-09-24

### Confirmed security/integration findings
- BLOCKER: non-genesis network blocks previously had no proposer-signature verification; production emitted zeroed signatures.
- CRITICAL: validator votes were cryptographically valid but the supplied public key was not bound to the registered validator identity.
- HIGH: slashing evidence was structural only and could not prove conflicting signed votes.
- HIGH: multiple Chain-ID/identity surfaces existed; wallet duplicate was removed.
- MEDIUM: atc-mining Rust implementation was not covered by its own Rust quality gates.
- MEDIUM: reward accounting mixes base-unit issuance with integer account balances.
- MEDIUM: weighted finality uses the mutable validator set instead of a height/epoch snapshot.

### Implemented in this PR
1. Wallet imports canonical NUMERIC_CHAIN_ID.
2. atc-mining gets Rust fmt/check/test/clippy gates.
3. atc-mining gets RustSec cargo-audit.
4. atc-mining is included in the central blockchain Rust matrix.
5. Validator registry now supports an explicit Ed25519 public key binding.
6. Votes require the signature public key to equal the registered validator key.
7. Non-genesis network blocks now require a valid Ed25519 proposer signature.
8. Block production signs the canonical block payload and rejects missing/mismatched proposer keys.
9. Node startup registers validator public keys derived from configured validator seeds.
10. Slashing now requires two cryptographically valid conflicting signed statements from the registered validator key.
11. E2E tests were updated to configure real validator signing keys.

### Protocol boundary
Genesis remains unsigned by design. Every non-genesis block entering through NetworkMessage::Block must have registered proposer -> registered Ed25519 key -> valid block signature.

### Still open
- Persist validator public keys in the durable validator snapshot.
- Replace mutable validator weighting with explicit height/epoch snapshots.
- Complete base-unit reward/dust accounting.
- Expand negative network/security tests and fuzz/property coverage.
- Complete legacy subtree call-graph audit before removal.

No CI gate was weakened and no tests were deleted. Local cargo execution is unavailable because the current environment cannot resolve GitHub's host; CI results are therefore treated as authoritative when posted.
